_readme: Pictures the owner adds to this folder (git-ignored apart from this file; personal use only). enemies: map an enemy sprite key (kraan, giak, vordak) to an image; dark ink on a light or transparent ground works best, it is multiplied onto the parchment. portrait: his likeness at the head of the Kai panel, {src, crop, fade}: crop [x, y, w, h] frames an ink drawing of him on light paper; the paper is keyed out and the edges fade into the page from fade (0-1) of the way out.
